title: Controversial Vaccine Trial in Africa Moves Forward Despite Ethical Concerns
subtitle: New research involving newborns in Guinea-Bissau faces strong criticism from health experts and internal resignations.

summary.en: A controversial medical trial involving newborns in Guinea-Bissau has received approval to proceed. The study will withhold the hepatitis B vaccine from some infants to test a specific research theory. Health experts argue the trial is unethical because it puts babies at risk of a lifelong, dangerous infection. Several members of the ethics committee resigned in protest against the project. The U.S. government has reportedly set aside funds to support the research despite the international outcry.
summary.zh: 一項涉及幾內亞比索新生兒的爭議性醫學試驗已獲准進行。該研究將對部分嬰兒暫緩接種 B 型肝炎疫苗，以驗證特定的研究理論。醫療專家認為此試驗極不道德，因為這使嬰兒面臨終身且危險的感染風險。倫理委員會有多名成員因抗議該計畫而辭職。據報導，儘管國際間強烈反對，美國政府仍撥款支持這項研究。

paragraphs.en: A controversial medical research trial that will withhold hepatitis B vaccines from some newborns in Guinea-Bissau has been given the green light to move forward. The study, which was previously suspended following international criticism, has now received approval from an ethics committee at the University of Southern Denmark. This decision has sparked renewed debate among health professionals about the safety and ethics of testing on infants in developing countries.
paragraphs.zh: 一項備受爭議的醫學研究試驗已獲准進行，該試驗將暫緩對幾內亞比索（Guinea-Bissau）部分新生兒接種 B 型肝炎疫苗。這項研究先前因國際輿論批評而暫停，如今已獲得南丹麥大學（University of Southern Denmark）倫理委員會的批准。此決定再次引發醫療專業人士對於在開發中國家對嬰兒進行測試之安全性和倫理問題的辯論。

paragraphs.en: The trial aims to enroll 14,000 infants. Under the research plan, half of the babies will receive the standard hepatitis B vaccine at birth, while the other half will not receive it for the first six weeks of life. Hepatitis B is a serious virus that can lead to liver damage, cancer, and early death. By delaying the vaccine, critics argue that the study intentionally leaves these infants vulnerable to a disease that is easily prevented.
paragraphs.zh: 該試驗計畫招募 1 萬 4 千名嬰兒。根據研究計畫，半數嬰兒將在出生時接種標準的 B 型肝炎疫苗，而另一半則在出生後的前六週內不予接種。B 型肝炎是一種嚴重的病毒，可能導致肝臟受損、癌症及過早死亡。批評者認為，透過延遲接種疫苗，這項研究刻意讓這些嬰兒暴露在極易預防的疾病風險之中。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the project is a key part of the vaccine vision for Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the secretary of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Kennedy has previously expressed skepticism about the safety and effectiveness of many common vaccines. At a recent conference, he praised the Danish researchers leading the study and suggested that this kind of research fits the current administration’s goals, which include reducing the number of vaccine recommendations in the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，該計畫是美國衛生及公共服務部部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）疫苗願景的核心部分。甘迺迪先前曾對許多常見疫苗的安全性和有效性表示懷疑。在最近的一場會議中，他稱讚了領導該研究的丹麥研究人員，並暗示這類研究符合現任政府的目標，其中包括減少美國國內的疫苗接種建議數量。

paragraphs.en: However, the project faces significant opposition. Stig Børsen Hansen, a reviewer who helped present the study to the Danish committee, resigned from his position in protest last week. He described the trial as a "lottery" where newborns are forced to participate in a test that could cause them permanent harm. "They contract hepatitis B in the context of being part of a research project," Hansen said, noting that the infection would happen by design rather than by accident. Three other members of the ethics committee also resigned in protest against the decision to proceed.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，該計畫面臨強烈反對。協助向丹麥委員會提交研究報告的審查員史迪格·波森·漢森（Stig Børsen Hansen）上週憤而辭職以示抗議。他將此試驗形容為一場「樂透」，新生兒被迫參與可能對其造成永久性傷害的測試。漢森表示：「他們是在參與研究計畫的過程中感染 B 型肝炎的。」他指出，這種感染是刻意設計而非意外。倫理委員會另有三名成員也因抗議該批准決定而辭職。

paragraphs.en: Experts in the United States have also raised alarms. Paul Offit, an infectious disease physician at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, stated that this type of trial would never be allowed in the U.S. due to strict ethical rules. Offit argued that the researchers are taking advantage of a developing nation, questioning whether the organizers believe that children in Africa are more expendable than those in the West. He noted that Kennedy’s ultimate goal appears to be ending the use of the birth dose of the hepatitis B vaccine in the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 美國的專家也發出警訊。費城兒童醫院（Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia）的傳染病醫師保羅·歐菲特（Paul Offit）指出，由於嚴格的倫理規範，這類試驗在美國絕不可能獲准。歐菲特認為研究人員是在利用開發中國家，並質疑主辦方是否認為非洲兒童比西方兒童更「可犧牲」。他指出，甘迺迪的最終目標似乎是終止美國新生兒接種 B 型肝炎疫苗的慣例。

paragraphs.en: Financial support for the project remains a point of contention. Ars Technica reports that the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has set aside $1.6 million for the trial. This funding would be taken from global health programs that might otherwise be used to fight other urgent health crises, such as the Ebola outbreak currently affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The project will also receive private funding from the Pershing Square Foundation and the Bluebell Foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 該計畫的財務支持仍是爭議焦點。據《Ars Technica》報導，美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）已為此試驗撥款 160 萬美元。這筆資金將從全球衛生計畫中挪用，而這些資金原本可用於對抗其他迫切的健康危機，例如目前影響剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情。該計畫也將獲得「波許廣場基金會」（Pershing Square Foundation）與「藍鈴基金會」（Bluebell Foundation）的私人資助。

paragraphs.en: In January, the minister of public health for Guinea-Bissau, Quinhin Nantote, had announced that the study was suspended because there was not enough coordination or agreement on its design. While the project has now been approved, details of the updated plan have not been made public. According to reports, the new protocol involves testing mothers for the virus before birth. If a mother tests positive, her baby will receive the vaccine and will not be part of the trial. However, babies of mothers who test negative may still be enrolled in the study.
paragraphs.zh: 今年 1 月，幾內亞比索公共衛生部長昆欣·南托特（Quinhin Nantote）曾宣布該研究因設計缺乏足夠的協調與共識而暫停。儘管該計畫現已獲准，但更新後的計畫細節尚未公開。據報導，新方案包含在產前對母親進行病毒檢測。若母親檢測呈陽性，其嬰兒將接種疫苗且不會被納入試驗；然而，母親檢測呈陰性的嬰兒仍可能被招募參與研究。

paragraphs.en: The researchers leading the project, Christine Stabell Benn and Peter Aaby, are currently under investigation by Danish authorities. They face allegations of scientific misconduct and falsification related to their previous work. Despite these investigations and the ongoing outcry from the global medical community, the trial is expected to continue. Neither the CDC, the Danish research team, nor the foundations providing the money have responded to requests for comment regarding the ethical concerns raised by the study.
paragraphs.zh: 領導該計畫的研究人員克莉絲汀·斯塔貝爾·班恩（Christine Stabell Benn）與彼得·阿比（Peter Aaby）目前正接受丹麥當局調查。他們面臨與先前研究相關的科學不端行為及偽造數據指控。儘管調查持續進行且全球醫學界抗議聲浪不斷，該試驗預計仍將繼續。美國疾病管制與預防中心、丹麥研究團隊以及提供資金的基金會，皆未回應針對該研究倫理疑慮的置評請求。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Permission to proceed with a project or activity.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意為交通號誌的綠燈，這裡引申為獲得批准。文中：A controversial medical research trial that will withhold hepatitis B vaccines from some newborns in Guinea-Bissau has been given the green light to move forward.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reserve or save something (usually money or time) for a specific purpose.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 撥出（款項）、預留（時間或資源）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指將資金專門留給某個項目使用。文中：Ars Technica reports that the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has set aside $1.6 million for the trial.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Happening because it was planned that way, not by chance.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 蓄意地、刻意地、按計畫地。
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易誤以為是「根據設計」，但這裡強調的是「刻意安排的結果」。文中：Hansen said, noting that the infection would happen by design rather than by accident.

quiz.question: According to the updated research protocol mentioned in the article, which infants will be excluded from the trial?

options.A: All infants born to mothers in Guinea-Bissau.
options.B: Infants whose mothers test positive for the hepatitis B virus.
options.C: Infants whose mothers test negative for the hepatitis B virus.
options.D: Infants who are part of the control group receiving the vaccine at birth.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第七段，更新後的試驗計畫規定，若母親檢測出 B 型肝炎病毒呈陽性，其嬰兒將直接接種疫苗並排除在試驗之外。選項 A 錯誤，因為只有部分嬰兒被排除；選項 C 錯誤，因為母親檢測陰性的嬰兒仍可能被納入試驗；選項 D 雖然提到疫苗接種，但並非排除標準，而是試驗分組的一部分。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the motivations behind the U.S. government's support for this study?

options.A: The government hopes to find a new, more effective vaccine for hepatitis B.
options.B: The government aims to provide better medical care for children in Africa.
options.C: The government intends to use the study's results to justify reducing vaccine recommendations in the U.S.
options.D: The government wants to prove that the current hepatitis B vaccine is dangerous for all newborns.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第三段與第五段，Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 對疫苗持懷疑態度，並表示此研究符合政府減少美國疫苗建議的目標。Paul Offit 也指出 Kennedy 的最終目的是結束美國出生後的 B 肝疫苗接種。選項 A 與文章目標矛盾；選項 B 僅是表面藉口，並非政府的核心動機；選項 D 過於誇大，文章並未提到要證明疫苗對所有新生兒都危險。

quiz.question: In the context of the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'expendable' mean?

options.A: Valuable and essential to the future of a society.
options.B: Able to be sacrificed or ignored without much concern.
options.C: Highly susceptible to rare and dangerous diseases.
options.D: Expensive to maintain and provide medical care for.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中，Paul Offit 質疑組織者是否認為非洲兒童比西方兒童更「expendable」（可犧牲的/無關緊要的），意指這些生命被視為可以為了研究目的而犧牲。選項 A 與原意相反；選項 C 雖然在討論疾病，但 expendable 並非指易受感染；選項 D 則與經濟成本無關，完全偏離語境。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: The scientific breakthroughs in hepatitis B research in Guinea-Bissau.
options.B: A detailed biography of the researchers leading the vaccine trial.
options.C: The medical benefits of delaying hepatitis B vaccinations for newborns.
options.D: The ethical controversy and political implications surrounding a controversial vaccine trial.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文從頭到尾都在討論這項試驗引發的倫理爭議、醫學界的反對聲浪、政治人物的動機，以及研究人員面臨的調查。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章重點在於爭議而非科學突破；選項 B 僅在最後一段簡短提及研究人員；選項 C 錯誤，文章並未探討延遲接種的醫學益處，反而強調其帶來的風險與道德質疑。
